results.description: SMALL TAXING UNIT NOTICE The City of Mingus will hold a meeting at 6:00 PM on September 9, 2026 at City Hall, 229 S. results.title: Visitors to Toft’s Dairy face 49 ice-cream choices
results.description: Toft’s Dairy in Sandusky, Ohio, has operated for more than a century and remains locally owned. Its ice-cream parlour offers 49 flavours, alongside food, coffee and dairy products.

results.description: NOTICE OF PUBLIC SALE Pursuant to Chapter 59, Texas Property Code, StoreMore LLC which is located at 2141 N FM 51 Weatherford, TX 76086 will hold a public auction of property being sold to satisfy a landlord's lien. The sale will be held at the following website address: https://storageauctions.net from September 4th, 2026 to September 11th, 2026. Property will be sold to highest bidder for cash. Deposit for removal and cleanup may be temporarily required. Seller reserves the right to not accept any bid and to withdraw property from sale. Property in each space may be sold item-by-item, in batches, or by the space. Property being sold includes contents in space(s) of the tenant listed below, with brief description of contents in the space(s): Jennifer Rumbaugh – Various Personal Effects. Christine Garner – Various Personal Effects.
